instances.claim: This tells me that Chang initiated the process of redefinition because value had become decoupled from the object and indeterminate — that the social contingency of value was the condition he was responding to.
instances.why: Line 18 holds the decision expression ('initiated'); lines 16 and 17 immediately before it state properties of value (decoupled from the object, a vessel for social consensus, indeterminate and continually redefined), so the sequence reads as condition-then-act. The draft does state an origin for his work — line 1, 'began with a simple value discrepancy', specified as copper versus face value in line 2 — but that is a different motive from the one this order supplies, and the indeterminacy in 16–17 is presented as a result of the five transformations the work performs, so the order makes an effect of the work into its reason.
